Cause: ext/tabs gives every .tab-bar overflow:auto on both axes and the -1px tab margin makes it 1px taller inside, so each embedded task page's tab strip is a vertical scroller that Chrome latches a whole wheel gesture to. AI dashboard has 8 strips (System design 4), the first one a third of the way down the column. Measured: 8 traps -> 0 on ai-dashboard, 0 on all 7 groups + 3 task cards at 1280/1920/2564/3440; tab strip pixels unchanged. Headless Chromium chains the wheel past the strip, so the full stop could not be shown headless; the traps were the only defect found on every ancestor.

assign.outcome:
**AI 2 now shows what everything cost: each group, each task, and each agent with its model. Detail pages fill the screen, and each task's cost is its own, not its parent's.**

- **See it:** [the AI dashboard group](/framework/ai2/2026/09/24/ai-dashboard/). Every rail row shows its cost. A group opens with a table of its tasks, largest first, each split into mastermind and minions. Each task's Report tab lists every agent with its model and dollars.
- **Costs are no longer copied:** a follow-up task that reused its parent's session used to show the parent's whole total. Now each task gets what was spent while it was open, and a minion counts toward the task it was started for. agent-chat went from $15.63 to $3.78, live-card-wide to $6.20, live-reply to $2.22, live-preview to $0.61 and task-audit to $43.44, and the shared agents still add up to $15.63 and $49.93.
- **Detail pages fill the page:** only running text and chat stay at reading width. Tables, the steps bar and the embedded task pages use the full column.
- **Two breaks you hit, fixed first:** the AI dashboard group page didn't scroll (each embedded task's tab strip was a 1px scroller that caught the wheel), and standalone task pages showed only their title (a name clash my groups change introduced).
